calendarFaqs.q: Are MCPSS Distance Learning Days student holidays?
calendarFaqs.a: No. MCPSS marks September 28 and November 3 as Virtual/Distance Learning days and includes them in the 176-student total. The calendar does not give participation details, so families should check MCPSS or their school for instructions for those days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the MCPSS Mardi Gras school closure in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: MCPSS's official online calendar lists February 8–12 as Mardi Gras Break (Student/Teacher Holiday), with school resuming Monday, February 15. The one-page PDF labels the same February 8–12 no-school period “Presidents' Day / Fat Tuesday.”

calendarFaqs.q: Why does the MCPSS calendar show 176 student days and 187 teacher days?
calendarFaqs.a: Teachers have additional professional development and workdays before school, during the year and after the last student day. The student total is the sum of the four printed quarter counts: 44 + 42 + 48 + 42 = 176.

calendarFaqs.q: Does the MCPSS calendar identify its eight flex days?
calendarFaqs.a: The PDF prints “8-FLEX DAYS” near the legend but does not name eight specific make-up dates or explain when they would be used. Do not treat a holiday or teacher workday as a make-up day unless MCPSS announces a schedule change.
Yes. Students are out both days, but MCPSS does not label them as Fall Break. October 12 is a Teacher Work Day and October 13 is Professional Development. Students return Wednesday, October 14.
